caption:
Fig. 1: Overview of our proposed evaluation paradigm. (a) HR A preserves structures,
while HR B shows severe distortions. (b) RefReward-SR uses an MLLM for inter-
pretable, LR-conditioned semantic scoring. (c) Existing metrics wrongly favor the dis-
torted HR B, whereas ours aligns with human perception. (d) RefReward-SR uniquely
ensures semantic fidelity and preference alignment without GT dependency. The as-
terisk(*) indicates that FR metrics evaluate high-level semantics only passively via
low-level correspondence.
